subject: StellaGrid onsite visit — logistics, calendar holds, and arrival plans
messages:
From: Kerry O'Neil <kerry.oneil@stellagrid.com>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.inference.com>
Cc: Luke Manning <luke.manning@stellagrid.com>, StellaGrid Events <events@stellagrid.com>
Date: 2026-07-06T18:05:00+01:00
Subject: StellaGrid - Onsite workshop (Proposed Jul 27-28)

Hi Vivek,

Thanks again for the quick sync last week. We’d like to host a two-day executive workshop at our London office the week of Jul 27. Preferred dates are Tue/Wed, Jul 27–28 — with the exec dinner on Tue evening (27th). Headcount will be ~14 (8 business stakeholders + 6 technical SMEs).

A few asks from our side to start logistics: 
- Can Redwood provide an initial agenda and confirm which presenters will lead the product deep dive?
- We need two breakout rooms (10ppl and 6ppl) and one main A/V-enabled room for panels.
- Please share travel recommendations for Redwood attendees (arrival night preference: Mon 26th evening).
- Any requirements for on-site security briefings (we have two execs who require one).

Attaching the attendee list (draft) for reference. Can someone on your team put calendar holds and hotel block proposals on this?

Best,
Kerry
Kerry O'Neil
Director, Partnerships — StellaGrid
Attachment: StellaGrid_attendees_v1.xlsx
From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.inference.com>
To: Kerry O'Neil <kerry.oneil@stellagrid.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.inference.com>, Laura Bennett <laura@redwood.inference.com>
Date: 2026-07-06T20:12:00-07:00
Subject: Re: StellaGrid - Onsite workshop (Proposed Jul 27-28)

Hi Kerry — thanks, this looks great and those dates work for us. We’ll plan to arrive Mon evening (26th) and be onsite full days Tue/Wed.

Quick notes / next steps:
- I’ll have Ben lead logistics (hotel blocks, A/V, room reservations) and Laura will take calendar invites and time-zone-friendly holds for both Redwood and StellaGrid stakeholders.
- Can you confirm whether the two execs requiring security briefings are US passport holders or need additional paperwork? If visa letters are required, let me know names and passport details and we’ll prioritize that.
- Please flag dietary restrictions on the attendee list and whether the dinner on Tue is formal (we’ll budget accordingly).

We’ll circulate a draft agenda by EOD tomorrow. I’ll also include a proposed mutual action plan so we’re aligned on outcomes (product/ops/next steps).

Vivek Kulkarni
Head of Sales, Redwood Inference
Redwood Inference — redwood.inference.com
From: Kerry O'Neil <kerry.oneil@stellagrid.com>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.inference.com>
Cc: Luke Manning <luke.manning@stellagrid.com>, StellaGrid Events <events@stellagrid.com>
Date: 2026-07-07T09:04:00+01:00
Subject: Re: StellaGrid - Onsite workshop (Proposed Jul 27-28)

Vivek — thanks, quick answers below and updated attendee list attached.
- Both execs are UK-based; no visa letters required. They do need a short security briefing (30 min) on Wed morning before the general session.
- Dinner is semi-formal; small head table for execs. We’ll capture dietary constraints in the updated sheet.
- Our facilities team can provide AV gear but will need Redwood’s A/V requirements and mic counts by Jul 15.

Luke and I will keep the events team in the loop for room setup. Looking forward to the agenda.

Thanks —
Kerry
Attachment: StellaGrid_attendees_v1_updated.xlsx
From: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.inference.com>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.inference.com>, Laura Bennett <laura@redwood.inference.com>
Date: 2026-07-07T11:30:00-07:00
Subject: Logistics plan draft — rooms, hotels, travel

Folks — putting a first-pass logistics plan here so we can move quickly. High level:
- Rooms: Reserve Main Hall (capacity 40, theater + projector), Breakout A (10ppl), Breakout B (6ppl). Confirmed tentative hold with StellaGrid facilities; final confirmation after we send AV spec.
- AV: Request 2 wireless lapel mics, 2 handhelds, projector + HDMI, confidence monitor for presenters. StellaGrid to confirm A/V fees.
- Hotel: Proposed room block at The Albion (walking distance). Block of 20 rooms, check-in Mon 26th, check-out Thu 29th to allow buffer. Estimated room rate and cut-off 2026-07-06.
- Travel: Recommended arrival window Mon 26th 18:00–22:00 local time. I’ll draft individual itineraries for Redwood attendees (arrival times + airport transfer details).
- Dinner: Exec dinner Tue 27th — preliminary reservation at Brindle & Co for 7:30pm. Estimated budget $120pp; Vivek, please approve or advise alternate budget.

Attachments: travel_itinerary_draft.xlsx, hotel_block_confirmation.pdf

Ben Carter
Enterprise Accounts — Redwood Inference
From: Laura Bennett <laura@redwood.inference.com>
To: Kerry O'Neil <kerry.oneil@stellagrid.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.inference.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.inference.com>
Date: 2026-07-07T15:00:00-07:00
Subject: Calendar holds and draft agenda (StellaGrid onsite — Jul 27-28)

Hi all — I created calendar holds in both BST/CET and PDT for Redwood attendees so times display correctly for your teams. Please review and accept when you can. Details below and links in the Drive folder.

Calendar holds (please accept):
- Jul 27, 09:00–17:00 BST — Main session + panels (Calendar: https://calendar.google.com/event?eid=stellagrid-onsite-20260727)
- Jul 28, 09:00–13:00 BST — Follow-ups, security briefing (Calendar: https://calendar.google.com/event?eid=stellagrid-onsite-20260728)

Drive: agenda (draft) and logistics folder here: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2b3cRedwood-StellaGrid-Workshop

Notes:
- Ben: please confirm A/V counts to StellaGrid facilities by Jul 15.
- Kerry: can you share the floorplan so I can map breakout rooms for invites?
- Vivek: approving dinner budget would let me finalize reservation and pre-authorize card hold.

I’ll send formal invites once we have final attendee list and Ben’s AV confirmation.

Thanks,
Laura Bennett
Program Manager, Partnerships — Redwood Inference
